import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneHighCompositionJets
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.ZPow
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv

/-!
# Fixed polynomial bounds for the actual logarithm jets

The coefficient is chosen before the numerical envelope and the field.
The positive value, its reciprocal, and the finite positive-order jets
are the only inputs. The zeroth logarithm is included without assuming
a bound on a real angular lift or on any constructed coordinate field.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Real
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

private theorem log_successor_jet_norm (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) Real.log x‖ =
      (j.factorial : ℝ) * |x⁻¹| ^ (j + 1) := by
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_succ',
    Real.deriv_log', iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_inv]
  have he : (-1 - (j : ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow]
  simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_one,
    one_pow, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg _)]

private theorem log_positive_jet_bound {H x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hInv : x⁻¹ ≤ H) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Real.log x‖ ≤
      ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ k := by
  have he : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
  have hn := log_successor_jet_norm (k - 1) x
  rw [he, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx)] at hn
  rw [hn]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr hx.le) hInv k) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

private theorem log_value_bound {H x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hVal : x ≤ H) (hInv : x⁻¹ ≤ H) : |Real.log x| ≤ H := by
  have hp := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx
  have hm := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx)
  rw [Real.log_inv] at hm
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm, hInv], by linarith only [hp, hVal]⟩

private def logJetCoefficient (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k, ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ)

private theorem logJetCoefficient_nonneg (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ logJetCoefficient k :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- All constants precede the numerical envelope, the point, and the
actual field. The exponent is displayed uniformly through order `N`. -/
theorem exists_log_finiteJet_polynomial_envelope
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {H : ℝ}, 1 ≤ H → ∀ (f : E → ℝ) (x : E),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x → 0 < f x → f x ≤ H → (f x)⁻¹ ≤ H →
      (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ ≤ H) →
      ∀ k, k ≤ N →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Real.log (f y)) x‖ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
  classical
  let C : ℝ := 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), logJetCoefficient j
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), logJetCoefficient j :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => logJetCoefficient_nonneg j
    dsimp only [C]
    linarith only [hp]
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro H hH f x hf hx hVal hInv hraw k hk
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := zero_le_one.trans hH
  have hpow0 : 0 ≤ H ^ (2 * N + 1) := pow_nonneg hH0 _
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · subst k
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      |Real.log (f x)| ≤ H := log_value_bound hx hVal hInv
      _ ≤ H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
        simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * N + 1)
      _ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left hpow0 hC
  have hpositive : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
  have hcomp := norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le_partition_sum
    (Real.contDiffAt_log.mpr hx.ne') hf k
  have hterm (π : OrderedFinpartition k) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ π.length Real.log (f x)‖ *
          ∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖ ≤
        ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
    have hout := log_positive_jet_bound hx hInv (π.length_pos hpositive)
    have hprod : (∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖) ≤ H ^ π.length := by
      simpa only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (s := Finset.univ)
          (f := fun j : Fin π.length => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖)
          (g := fun _ : Fin π.length => H) (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
          (fun j _ => hraw (π.partSize j) (π.partSize_pos j)
            ((π.partSize_le j).trans hk)))
    calc
      _ ≤ (((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ π.length) * H ^ π.length :=
        mul_le_mul hout hprod (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hH0 _))
      _ = ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * π.length) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
        congr 2
        omega
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by have hp := π.length_le; omega)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hcoeff : logJetCoefficient k ≤ C := by
    have hm : k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => logJetCoefficient_nonneg j) hm).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ π.length Real.log (f x)‖ *
          ∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖ := hcomp
    _ ≤ ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k,
        ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * N + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun π _ => hterm π
    _ = logJetCoefficient k * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rfl
    _ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff hpow0

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveHeightTaylorInterpolation

/-!
# Reference identities for the actual radial Taylor data

A genuine joint identity germ determines every radial trace. The
displayed finite polynomials therefore reproduce the two projections,
and a unit height germ makes the logarithmic interpolation exactly one.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ
    {F G : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] G) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    radialBoundaryJet F c j θ = radialBoundaryJet G c j θ := by
  have hline : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x, θ)) (𝓝 c) (𝓝 (c, θ)) :=
    (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).tendsto c
  exact ((h θ).comp_tendsto hline).iteratedDeriv_eq j

theorem boundaryTaylorPolynomial_snd (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial n c (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) c) =
      (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  funext p
  unfold boundaryTaylorPolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
      div_one, pow_zero, mul_one]
  · intro j _ hj
    simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_const, if_neg hj, zero_div, zero_mul]
  · intro hzero
    exact (hzero (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))).elim

theorem boundaryTaylorPolynomial_fst (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1) c (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c) =
      (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  funext p
  have hterm (j : ℕ) :
      radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c j p.2 /
          (j.factorial : ℝ) * (p.1 - c) ^ j =
        (if j = 0 then c else 0) + (if j = 1 then p.1 - c else 0) := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
        div_one, pow_zero, mul_one, if_pos rfl, Nat.zero_ne_one, ite_false, ite_true, add_zero]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_fun_id, Nat.factorial_one,
          Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one, one_mul, Nat.one_ne_zero, ite_false, if_pos rfl,
          ite_true, zero_add]
      · simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_fun_id, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1,
          zero_div, zero_mul, zero_add]
  have hzero : 0 ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hone : 1 ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  simp only [boundaryTaylorPolynomial, hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', hzero, hone, ite_true]
  ring

theorem oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_snd
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative n c F = (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have he : radialBoundaryJet F c = radialBoundaryJet (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) c := by
    funext j θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ h j θ
  rw [oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative, he, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_snd]

theorem oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_fst
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative (n + 1) c F = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have he : radialBoundaryJet F c = radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c := by
    funext j θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ h j θ
  rw [oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative, he, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_fst]

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_reference_one
    (n : ℕ) (l r δ : ℝ) {h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hOne : ∀ side θ, h side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hzero (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h side j θ = 0 := by
    have hlog : ∀ η, boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h side) =ᶠ[
        𝓝 (if side then r else l, η)] (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro η
      filter_upwards [hOne side η] with p hp
      simp only [boundaryHeightLogRatio, hp, div_one, Real.log_one]
    have he := radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ hlog j θ
    simpa only [positiveHeightTaylorData, radialBoundaryJet,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_const_zero] using he
  funext p
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, endpointTaylorCorrection,
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial, hzero, zero_div, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveHeightTaylorInterpolation
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AngularTaylorPolynomial

/-!
# Value bounds for the actual logarithmic height interpolation

A collar small enough for the positive Taylor orders keeps each
logarithmic polynomial within one of its boundary value. Bounds for
the given height and its reciprocal therefore yield a polynomial
amplitude bound for the constructed height and its reciprocal.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_one_germ
    (n : ℕ) {l r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (p : PolarPoint) (hL : p.1 ∉ Metric.ball l δ) (hR : p.1 ∉ Metric.ball r δ) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h =ᶠ[𝓝 p]
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hleft := (positiveEndpointCutoff_zero_germ_of_not_mem_ball hδ hL).comp_tendsto
    (continuous_fst.continuousAt (x := p))
  have hright := (positiveEndpointCutoff_zero_germ_of_not_mem_ball hδ hR).comp_tendsto
    (continuous_fst.continuousAt (x := p))
  filter_upwards [hleft, hright] with y hyL hyR
  have hyL' : positiveEndpointCutoff l δ y.1 = 0 := hyL
  have hyR' : positiveEndpointCutoff r δ y.1 = 0 := hyR
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, endpointTaylorCorrection,
    hyL', hyR', zero_mul, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_amplitude
    (n : ℕ) {l r δ M H : ℝ} {h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hpositive : ∀ side θ, 0 < h side (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hupper : ∀ side θ, h side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H)
    (hinverse : ∀ side θ, (h side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H)
    (hlog : ∀ side j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ∀ θ,
      |positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hsmall : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ 1) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h p ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 ∧
      (positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h p)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
  let A := positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h
  let e : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else l
  have hHpos : 0 < H := zero_lt_one.trans_le hH
  have hlogH : 0 ≤ Real.log H := Real.log_nonneg hH
  have hA0 (side : Bool) : |A side 0 p.2| ≤ Real.log H := by
    have hu := Real.log_le_log (hpositive side p.2) (hupper side p.2)
    have hi := Real.log_le_log (inv_pos.mpr (hpositive side p.2)) (hinverse side p.2)
    rw [Real.log_inv] at hi
    change |Real.log (h side (e side, p.2) / 1)| ≤ Real.log H
    rw [div_one]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hu⟩
  have hterm (side : Bool) :
      |positiveEndpointCutoff (e side) δ p.1 *
        boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) p| ≤ Real.log H + 1 := by
    apply abs_positiveEndpointCutoff_mul_le
      (f := fun x => boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) (x, p.2))
      hδ (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log H + 1)
    intro x hx
    have hx' : |x - e side| ≤ δ := by
      exact (show |x - e side| < δ from (by
        simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hx)).le
    have hd := (abs_boundaryTaylorPolynomial_sub_zero_le
      hδ.le hδone hM hx' (fun j hj hjn => hlog side j hj hjn p.2)).trans hsmall
    have ht := abs_add_le
      (boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) (x, p.2) - A side 0 p.2) (A side 0 p.2)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at ht
    linarith only [ht, hd, hA0 side]
  have hE : |endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p| ≤ 2 * (Real.log H + 1) := by
    have hleft := hterm false
    have hright := hterm true
    change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p +
      positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p| +
        |positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p| ≤ _ at hleft
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _ at hright
      linarith)
  have hexp : Real.exp (2 * (Real.log H + 1)) = Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
    rw [show 2 * (Real.log H + 1) = 2 + (Real.log H + Real.log H) by ring,
      Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hHpos]
    ring
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, one_mul]
  change Real.exp (endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p) ≤ _ ∧
    (Real.exp (endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p))⁻¹ ≤ _
  constructor
  · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans hE)).trans_eq hexp
  · rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((neg_le_abs _).trans hE)).trans_eq hexp

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveFiberCoordinates
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.CanonicalEndpointInverse

/-!
# Closed geometry and symmetries of positive fiber coordinates

The scalar interpolation supplies positive radial and angular derivatives.
The resulting actual global inverse maps the closed strips as well as the
open strips. Periodicity and reflection are inherited from the two scalar
fields, and their genuine global inverse supplies the boundary inverse germ.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem positiveFiberChart_period_add
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} {T : ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ r θ, φ (r, θ + T) = φ (r, θ) + T)
    (hY : ∀ r η, Y (r, η + T) = Y (r, η)) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveFiberChart φ Y (p + (0, T)) = positiveFiberChart φ Y p + (0, T) := by
  rcases p with ⟨r, θ⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, hφ, hY]
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, hφ]

theorem positiveFiberChart_reflect
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ r θ, φ (r, -θ) = -φ (r, θ))
    (hY : ∀ r η, Y (r, -η) = Y (r, η)) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveFiberChart φ Y (p.1, -p.2) =
      ((positiveFiberChart φ Y p).1, -(positiveFiberChart φ Y p).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, hφ, hY]
  · exact hφ p.1 p.2

/-- Reflection of the inverse follows from the two genuine inverse
identities and reflection of the forward map. -/
theorem inverse_reflect_of_forward_reflect
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse G F) (hright : Function.RightInverse G F)
    (hreflect : ∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2))
    (p : PolarPoint) : G (p.1, -p.2) = ((G p).1, -(G p).2) := by
  apply hleft.injective
  rw [hright, hreflect, hright]

/-- The Jacobian of a genuinely reflection-equivariant differentiable
map is even. This uses the actual chain rule twice. -/
theorem planeJacobian_even_of_angle_reflection
    {F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (hreflect : ∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2))
    (p : PolarPoint) : planeJacobian F (p.1, -p.2) = planeJacobian F p := by
  let R : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := fun q => (q.1, -q.2)
  have hR (q : PolarPoint) : DifferentiableAt ℝ R q :=
    differentiableAt_fst.prodMk differentiableAt_snd.neg
  have hRJ (q : PolarPoint) : planeJacobian R q = -1 := by
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun x : PolarPoint => -x.2)
        (-(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) q := hasFDerivAt_snd.fun_neg
    rw [planeJacobian_preserve_first hd.differentiableAt]
    unfold angularPartial
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
  have he : F ∘ R = R ∘ F := funext hreflect
  have hj := congrArg (fun H : PolarPoint → PolarPoint => planeJacobian H p) he
  rw [planeJacobian_comp (hR p) (hF (R p)),
    planeJacobian_comp (hF p) (hR (F p)), hRJ p, hRJ (F p)] at hj
  change planeJacobian F (R p) = planeJacobian F p
  linarith only [hj]

/-- The actual global left inverse agrees near the image point with the
smooth local inverse supplied by the ordinary inverse function theorem. -/
theorem canonicalBoundaryInverseGerm_of_global_leftInverse
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F p) (hJ : planeJacobian F p ≠ 0)
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse G F) : CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm F G p := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hp, hsmooth⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_localInverse_of_planeJacobian_ne_zero hF hJ
  refine ⟨e, he, hp, hsmooth, ?_⟩
  have htarget : F p ∈ e.target := by
    rw [← he]
    exact e.map_source hp
  filter_upwards [e.open_target.mem_nhds htarget] with q hq
  calc
    G q = G (F (e.symm q)) := by
      rw [← he, e.right_inv hq]
    _ = e.symm q := hleft _

/-- The exact endpoint values and the proved radial monotonicity control
both closed-strip maps. No boundary value is assigned to a total inverse. -/
theorem positiveFiberChart_maps_closedStrip
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    {B l r α β : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hYLower : ∀ x η, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, η)) x)
    (hleft : ∀ η, Y (l, η) = α) (hright : ∀ η, Y (r, η) = β) :
    MapsTo (positiveFiberChart φ Y) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
        (Icc α β ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∧
      MapsTo (positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y) (Icc α β ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
        (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
  have hmono (η : ℝ) : StrictMono (fun x => Y (x, η)) :=
    strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun x => hB.trans_le (hYLower x η))
  have hR := (positiveFiberRadialInverse_properties hY hB hYLower).2.1
  constructor
  · intro p hp
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, mem_univ _⟩
    · change α ≤ Y (p.1, φ p)
      rw [← hleft (φ p)]
      exact (hmono (φ p)).monotone hp.1.1
    · change Y (p.1, φ p) ≤ β
      rw [← hright (φ p)]
      exact (hmono (φ p)).monotone hp.1.2
  · intro q hq
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, mem_univ _⟩
    · change l ≤ positiveFiberRadialInverse Y q
      by_contra hnot
      have hh := hmono q.2 (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      dsimp only at hh
      rw [hR q, hleft q.2] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hq.1.1) hh
    · change positiveFiberRadialInverse Y q ≤ r
      by_contra hnot
      have hh := hmono q.2 (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      dsimp only at hh
      rw [hR q, hright q.2] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hq.1.2) hh

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveReferenceCollarPrescribedWidth
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PrescribedEndpointWidth
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveFiberInterpolationSymmetry
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.TwoEndpointFiberGluing

/-!
# An actual radial fiber from two endpoint jet families

The two endpoint values are their physical radii.  The positive first
normal jets and bounded finite normal jets choose displayed collar widths
before the family index.  The integral construction supplies a genuine
positive radial derivative everywhere and matches the identity between
the two exits as a joint germ.  No determinant condition is needed at the
physical endpoints, so they may be turning radii.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def endpointFiberWidths (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) (side : Bool) : ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  prescribedEndpointWidth n (b - a) 1 κ M
    (max (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) 1) (b - a)

def endpointFiberLower (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
  min (prescribedPositiveCollarLower l c (η false) (c - l) κ 1)
    (min 1 (prescribedPositiveCollarLower d r (η true) (r - d) κ 1))

def endpointFiberCollar (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (side : Bool) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n a b (η side) a (b - a) side
    (A side) Prod.fst

def endpointFiberInterpolation (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d (endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η A) Prod.fst

theorem twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_reference_germ_on_middle
    {Y : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {Ref : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
    (hcd : c < d)
    (hmatch : ∀ side θ, Y side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then d else c, θ)] Ref)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc c d) (θ : ℝ) :
    twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d Y Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] Ref := by
  have hright (α : ℝ) : Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (d, α)] Y true := (hmatch true α).symm
  have hleft (α : ℝ) : Y false =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, α)] radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) := by
    have hi := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hright (c, α)
    change radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, α)]
      (if c < d then Ref else Y true) at hi
    rw [if_pos hcd] at hi
    exact (hmatch false α).trans hi.symm
  have ho := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hleft (x, θ)
  change twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d Y Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)]
    (if x < c then Y false else radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true)) at ho
  rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_ge hx.1)] at ho
  have hi := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hright (x, θ)
  change radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)]
    (if x < d then Ref else Y true) at hi
  by_cases hxd : x < d
  · rw [if_pos hxd] at hi
    exact ho.trans hi
  · have he : x = d := le_antisymm hx.2 (le_of_not_gt hxd)
    rw [if_neg hxd] at hi
    exact (ho.trans hi).trans (by simpa only [he, ↓reduceIte] using hmatch true θ)

theorem endpointFiberInterpolation_family
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} {A : ι → Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    {l r c d κ M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hA : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (A i side j))
    (hvalue : ∀ i side θ, A i side 0 θ = if side then r else l)
    (hlow : ∀ i side θ, κ ≤ A i side 1 θ)
    (hbound : ∀ i side j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, |A i side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hperiod : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → Function.Periodic (A i side j) Real.pi)
    (heven : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, A i side j (-θ) = A i side j θ) :
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κ M
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d η (A i)
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet Y (if side then r else l) k θ = A i side k θ := by
  let a : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then d else l
  let b : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else c
  let η : Bool → ℝ := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
  let Y : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η (A i)
  let B : Bool → ℝ := fun side =>
    prescribedPositiveCollarLower (a side) (b side) (η side)
      (b side - a side) κ 1
  have hab (side : Bool) : a side < b side := by
    cases side <;> assumption
  have hmarg (side : Bool) := prescribedEndpointWidth_margins n
    (sub_pos.mpr (hab side)) zero_lt_one hκ hM
    (zero_le_one.trans (le_max_right (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) 1))
    (sub_pos.mpr (hab side))
  have hcollar (side : Bool) :
      0 < B side ∧ ∀ i,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y i side) ∧
      (∀ x θ, B side ≤ deriv (fun t => Y i side (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ (s : Bool) θ, Y i side (if s then b side else a side, θ) =
        if s then a side + (b side - a side) else a side) ∧
      (∀ k ≤ n + 1, ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (Y i side) (if side then b side else a side) k θ =
          A i side k θ) ∧
      (∀ s, s ≠ side → ∀ θ,
        Y i side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if s then b side else a side, θ)]
          (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) := by
    apply positiveReferenceCollar_family_of_width side
      (hab side) zero_lt_one hκ hM zero_lt_one zero_le_one (sub_pos.mpr (hab side))
      (hmarg side).1 (hmarg side).2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.1
      (hmarg side).2.2.2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.2.2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.2.2.2
      (fun i j hj => hA i side j hj)
    · intro i θ
      cases side with
      | false => exact hvalue i false θ
      | true =>
        calc
          A i true 0 θ = r := hvalue i true θ
          _ = a true + (b true - a true) := by dsimp only [a, b]; ring
    · exact fun i θ => hlow i side θ
    · exact fun i j hj hjn θ => hbound i side j hj hjn θ
    · exact contDiff_fst
    · intro s hs θ
      cases side <;> cases s <;> simp_all [a, b]
    · intro s hs x hx θ
      exact le_of_eq radialPartial_fst.symm
    · intro s hs x hx θ
      simp only [radialPartial_fst, abs_one, le_refl]
  have hη (side : Bool) : 0 < η side := (hmarg side).1
  have hηgap (side : Bool) : 2 * η side < b side - a side :=
    (hmarg side).2.2.2.1
  have hY (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y i side) :=
    ((hcollar side).2 i).1
  have hYlow (i : ι) (side : Bool) (p : PolarPoint) :
      B side ≤ radialPartial (Y i side) p := by
    have h := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.1 p.1 p.2
    rwa [deriv_cylinder_radial_slice ((hY i side).differentiable (by simp))] at h
  have hmatch (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      Y i side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then d else c, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
    have hs : (!side) ≠ side := by cases side <;> decide
    have h := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.2.2.2 (!side) hs θ
    cases side <;> simpa only [a, b, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] using h
  have hg (i : ι) := twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_geometry hcd (hY i) contDiff_fst
    (hmatch i) (fun side => (hcollar side).1) zero_lt_one (hYlow i)
    (fun p => le_of_eq radialPartial_fst.symm)
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hη, hηgap, lt_min (hcollar false).1 (lt_min zero_lt_one (hcollar true).1), ?_⟩
  intro i
  let W := endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d η (A i)
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := (hg i).1
  have hboundary (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      radialBoundaryJet W (if side then r else l) k θ = A i side k θ := by
    have he := twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_endpoint_germ hlc hcd hdr (hmatch i) side θ
    have hline : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x, θ)) (𝓝 (if side then r else l))
        (𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)) :=
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).tendsto _
    have hd := ((he.comp_tendsto hline).iteratedDeriv k).eq_of_nhds
    change radialBoundaryJet W (if side then r else l) k θ =
      radialBoundaryJet (Y i side) (if side then r else l) k θ at hd
    have hj := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.2.2.1 k hk θ
    cases side <;> exact hd.trans hj
  have hsymm (χ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (hInv : ∀ side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, A i side j (χ θ) = A i side j θ)
      (x θ : ℝ) : W (x, χ θ) = W (x, θ) := by
    apply twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_angleInvariant c d χ
    · intro side s α
      exact positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate_angleInvariant
        (fun j hj => hA i side j hj) contDiff_fst χ
        (fun j hj β => hInv side j hj β) (fun _ _ => rfl)
        (a side) (b side) (η side) (a side) (b side - a side) side s α
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  refine ⟨hW, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hboundary⟩
  · intro x θ
    rw [deriv_cylinder_radial_slice (hW.differentiable (by simp)) x θ]
    exact (hg i).2.2 (x, θ)
  · intro θ
    simpa only [W, η, radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using
      (hboundary false 0 (Nat.zero_le _) θ).trans (hvalue i false θ)
  · intro θ
    simpa only [W, η, radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using
      (hboundary true 0 (Nat.zero_le _) θ).trans (hvalue i true θ)
  · exact hsymm (fun θ => θ + Real.pi) (fun side j hj θ => hperiod i side j hj θ)
  · exact hsymm (fun θ => -θ) (fun side j hj θ => heven i side j hj θ)
  · exact fun x hx θ => twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_reference_germ_on_middle hcd
      (hmatch i) hx θ

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis
